 By Trevor Wang Published on October 22, 2026 Source: TopSphere Media / Unsplash Cincinnati is starting Thursday with fog and mist around Lunken Airport, but the gray opening should give way to a sunny afternoon near 70. Visibility at Lunken Airport was 10 miles early Thursday.
 Fog Gives Way To A Sunny Afternoon
 The fog is expected to lift before 10 a.m., followed by mostly sunny skies and north-northeast winds below 10 knots. According to the National Weather Service , rain chances are essentially zero Thursday, with temperatures reaching around 70 before dropping to about 44 under clear skies.
 Warm, Dry Weekend Takes Shape
 Friday may bring patchy fog, then sunshine and a high near 70. Saturday rises to 71 and Sunday to 73, while overnight lows stay in the mid-40s and light winds keep conditions calm.
 Summerlike Warmth Lingers Into Monday
 Monday looks mostly sunny with a high near 74, the warmest day in the near-term outlook. Tuesday looks partly sunny to partly cloudy, with highs around 68 to 70 and a 0% chance of rain; Wednesday brings morning clouds and afternoon sun, with highs in the low 70s and a 5% chance of rain. Overall, the dry pattern is expected to hold through at least early next week.
 For outdoor plans, the forecast favors sunny afternoons, though early mornings and evenings will still feel distinctly fall-like. A light jacket should cover the chilly bookends, while the middle of the day looks comfortable enough for a walk, patio lunch or one last excuse to leave the house before winter remembers Cincinnati exists.
